Exceptional grooming experience at Woof Gang Bakery & Grooming Aventura!

We brought our Yorkie, Cookie, in for grooming, and the entire experience was outstanding. The team was welcoming, professional, and clearly takes great pride in caring for every pet.

Cookie came out looking absolutely beautiful, perfectly groomed, fresh, clean, and adorable. The attention to detail was excellent, and most importantly, she looked happy and comfortable after her appointment.

It’s wonderful to find a place where you can feel confident leaving your pet in caring and capable hands. We are extremely pleased with the quality of the grooming and the overall service.

Highly recommended! Cookie will definitely be coming back. 🐾❤️

If i could give them a zero star review i would. I dropped off the dog myself and had my boyfriend pick him up. What a disaster. We use Wolfgang in Boca Raton And have had nothing but amazing experiences. I was hoping for the same experience here in Aventura, but it was a total opposite.

First off, they shaved my dog way too short and did not give the specific cut i was looking for after showing pictures. secondly, my dog is allergic to chicken and they provided a chicken treat to my dog without informing my boyfriend or i prior. Third, The groomer use zero clipper on my dog rear end. My dog has been scooting for the last 12 hours in discomfort.

When my boyfriend picked up the dog, she was the one that mentioned it to him and said the reason she shaved it was “ so poop doesn’t get stuck” but when we dropped off the dog, there was no poop in there to begin with so idk what made her think that was okay?
my dog has been so down since returning - hasn’t eaten any treats - something seems so off with his energy. i’m so disappointed with this location. such a shame.
Thank you so much for the 5-star review! ⭐️ We truly appreciate your support and are so happy to have you and your pup as part of the Woof Gang family!
Excellent service. My Kiara left happy 🥰 …

I’m very disappointed with the grooming service I received. I showed the groomer a photo of my own dog from his previous grooming and specifically asked for him to be groomed the same way.

Unfortunately, what I received looks nothing like the reference I provided. The shape of his face, muzzle, head, and ears is completely different, and his hair was cut significantly shorter in several areas. I understand that grooming can never be 100% identical, but the reference photo was literally of the same dog, so there should not have been this much of a difference.

What was even more disappointing was how the situation was handled afterward. Despite the obvious difference between what I requested and the result, no compensation, refund, credit, or other solution was offered. There was no meaningful attempt to make things right.

If a groomer is unable to reproduce a requested style or believes it won’t be possible, I would much rather be told beforehand so we can discuss alternatives. Once the hair is cut this short, there is obviously no way to fix it other than waiting for it to grow back.
Amazing , 12/10.
Good service. The shop is very cute and has many treats for your furry friends. Grooming is excellent, they take great care of the animals and leave them gorgeous.

I took my three dogs here for a full grooming and I’m really happy with the service! They did an excellent job and all three came out looking clean, fresh, and perfectly groomed. You can tell they took their time and treated them with care. It’s not easy to find a place you feel comfortable leaving your dogs, especially three at once, but I had a great experience here. Definitely recommended and I’ll be bringing them back! ⭐️

Was extremely impressed by the grooming done here by Evelyn! She went out of her way to make sure our maltipoo had an amazing haircut. The haircut was done very quickly but with a lot of attention to detail. Will definitely be coming here from now on
Thank you for the 5 stars! Your support means the world to us. It was a pleasure caring for your pup, and we'll see you again soon! 🐾 …

Ive been coming here for over 5 years. My dog doesnt want to leave when I come pick him up and I think that says everything about how caring and loving this place is. From the owner Juliana to our groomer, Felicia, I’ve never had anything short of an amazing experience!!!!!

I had a very disappointing experience. After I paid for my dog’s grooming and the transaction was already completed, my husband went to pick up our dog. Not only did they forget to put on the bow they usually include, but they also charged us additional money after the grooming had already been completed and paid for.

I find this very unprofessional. Any additional charges should be discussed with and approved by the customer before completing the service and processing payment—not after the fact. This experience left us feeling frustrated and disappointed.

I decided to take my dog in for the complimentary grooming that was advertised on Instagram in exchange for using him as a grooming model. My expectation was that, if a dog is being used to represent a business on social media, they would take extra care, spend the necessary time, and do their best work. Unfortunately, our experience was the complete opposite.

My appointment was on a Saturday morning. My dog did have a few small mats, but they were nowhere near severe enough to justify shaving him almost down to the skin. When I arrived to pick him up, I was shocked to see that he had been shaved almost completely. I didn’t say anything at the time because I didn’t want to cause a scene—I simply took my dog and left.

The saddest part is seeing how much this experience has affected him. It’s been two days, and he’s still acting depressed and withdrawn. He’s normally a happy, energetic, playful dog who gets excited about everything, but since the grooming he hasn’t been himself at all.

I’m leaving this review so others are aware that a “free grooming for modeling” doesn’t necessarily mean your pet will receive extra care or attention. In our case, it certainly didn’t.

To top it off, it’s been two days since the appointment, and I still haven’t seen a single photo of my dog posted on their social media—the very reason we agreed to participate in the first place.
